# Audiere 1.9.2 SDK

`audiere.h` and `license.txt` are copied unchanged from the HoMM2 Buka donor
at revision `e0689d3f71b2942b544fd677cb54085a13503d7b`, directory
`vendor/audiere-1.9.2`. The SDK declares the two entry points imported by the
HoMM1 Buka executable and the reference-counted virtual interfaces it calls.
The bundled LGPL license applies to these SDK files.

The runtime DLL remains an external, hash-pinned retail input. It is not
redistributed in this directory.
